meta.name: appinsights-instrumentation
meta.description: Guidance for instrumenting webapps with Azure Application Insights. Provides telemetry patterns, SDK setup, and configuration references. WHEN: how to instrument app, App Insights SDK, telemetry patterns, what is App Insights, Application Insights guidance, instrumentation examples, APM best practices.

copy.tagline: 给网页应用加上运行追踪,看清报错和性能数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在开发网页应用,想了解用户行为和程序报错。
copy.tagline_en: Add runtime monitoring to web apps to surface errors and performance data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build web apps and want visibility into usage and errors.

howto.what: 装好后，当用户询问如何为 Web 应用接入 Azure Application Insights 时，Claude 会给出自动或手动插桩指南、SDK 设置和配置参考；如果用户要求真正添加组件，Claude 会转给 azure-prepare 技能。
howto.when: 当用户询问如何为托管在 Azure 的 ASP.NET Core 或 Node.js 应用接入 Application Insights，或需要 SDK 安装、遥测模式等指导时触发。若用户要求直接修改项目，改用 azure-prepare。

容器应用 App Insights 观测怎么配？

howto.what_en: Installed: when asked how to instrument a web app with Azure Application Insights, Claude gives auto/manual guides, SDK setup, and config references. If asked to modify the project, Claude routes to azure-prepare.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks how to instrument an ASP.NET Core or Node.js app hosted in Azure with App Insights, or needs SDK setup and telemetry guidance. Direct project changes go to azure-prepare.

say_en.text: My ASP.NET Core app is hosted in Azure App Service. How do I add App Insights?
say_en.note: Claude will prefer auto-instrument and show steps.

say_en.text: How do I set up the SDK to add telemetry to a Node.js app?
say_en.note: Claude provides the Node.js guide and SDK reference.

say_en.text: How should Application Insights observability be configured for a container app?
say_en.note: Claude provides the container apps observability guide.
